text.text: Your portfolio in one place. Check Rent payments due, Leases ending soon, Maintenance requests scheduled this week, and which Units are vacant. Operational tracking only; keep signed leases and notices in your document system.
Same dates every month make late rent easy to spot.
Use Record rent due on each lease.
Send reminders three days before the due date.
Mark late payments Late and send the notice the lease calls for.
Call tenants who are more than three days late.
Record partial payments and any payment plan in the notes.
Total Received against Amount and review Still owed.
Mark the lease Notice given and the unit Notice given.
Mark the unit Turnover and log requests for cleaning and repairs.
Compare move-in and move-out condition and record any deposit deductions.
Update photos, mark the unit Vacant and list it.
Decide priority first, then who and when.
Emergency: safety or major damage. Call the vendor immediately.
Urgent: no heat or water, security. Same or next day.
Choose a vendor, schedule and tell the tenant.
Mark Done only after the tenant confirms.
Open Leases, Next 30 days view, and look further ahead on All leases.
Check rent against the market and decide the offer.
Send the renewal offer and mark Renewal offered.
Mark Notice given and start the turnover steps.
